name: adapt_cart_limit_cpp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into cart.hpp
prompts: Create a header-only cart.hpp declaring an inline bool app::can_add(int count) returning true if count is less than or equal to the integer in max_items.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (std::ifstream) at call time - do not hardcode it.
max_items.txt has changed. Make sure can_add() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: max_items.txt tightened to a lower limit

test_setup_files.test_cart.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++17', 'test_cart_main.cpp', '-o', 'test_cart_bin'], check=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['./test_cart_bin'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr[-300:]}'
assert 'PASS' in proc.stdout
print('PASS')
